description: This file implements a mock class ArrayCsrfTokenStorage for unit testing purposes. It provides in-memory storage and management of CSRF tokens, implementing methods to get, set, remove, and check the existence of tokens, conforming to Symfony's TokenStorageInterface.

classes.name: ArrayCsrfTokenStorage
classes.description: A mock implementation of Symfony's TokenStorageInterface for testing CSRF token storage in-memory.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the CSRF token associated with the given ID, throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Stores a CSRF token under a specified ID.

methods.name: removeToken
methods.description: Removes the CSRF token associated with the given ID, returning the token if it existed.

methods.name: hasToken
methods.description: Checks if a token with the given ID exists in storage.
